pitch_en: Operates SLOW, collecting and transforming post-consumer and post-industrial textile waste into reusable materials for fashion, furniture, and design.
pitch_es: Opera SLOW, recolectando y transformando residuos textiles posconsumo e industriales en materiales reutilizables para moda, mobiliario y diseno.
cta_pitch_en: Regenerative textile materials with traceability for architecture and design projects.
cta_pitch_es: Materiales textiles regenerativos con trazabilidad para proyectos de arquitectura y diseno.

sections.head_en: Textile waste from production and post-consumer streams often ends in landfill instead of productive reuse loops.
sections.head_es: Residuos textiles de produccion y posconsumo a menudo terminan en relleno en lugar de bucles productivos de reutilizacion.
sections.body_en: Textile waste from production and post-consumer streams often ends in landfill instead of productive reuse loops.

steps.text_en: SLOW service: collection, sorting, traceability, and material products for architecture, interiors, and brands.
steps.text_es: Servicio SLOW: recoleccion, clasificacion, trazabilidad y productos de material para arquitectura, interiores y marcas.
